response.sql:
WITH media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    mt.Name,
    CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS DECIMAL(20,10)) / CAST(SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS DECIMAL(20,10)) as rate
  FROM Track t
  INNER JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
),
rate_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) as mean_rate
  FROM media_type_stats
)
SELECT 
  mts.Name,
  mts.rate,
  mts.rate / rm.mean_rate as normalized_rate
FROM media_type_stats mts
CROSS JOIN rate_mean rm

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with NULL Bytes are included in the Milliseconds denominator but excluded from the Bytes numerator (SQL's default SUM behavior). The request's phrase 'all its tracks' refers to all tracks matched to that media type, regardless of whether Bytes is recorded.

alternatives.interpretation: Only include tracks with non-NULL Bytes in both the numerator and denominator sums, filtering out incomplete records entirely.

WITH media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    mt.Name,
    CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS DECIMAL(20,10)) / CAST(SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS DECIMAL(20,10)) as rate
  FROM Track t
  INNER JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
),
rate_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) as mean_rate
  FROM media_type_stats
)
SELECT 
  mts.Name,
  mts.rate,
  mts.rate / rm.mean_rate as normalized_rate
FROM media_type_stats mts
CROSS JOIN rate_mean rm
